name: ALLEY
caption: Meet Alley, the fiery Queen cat of Katraj 👑 #katraj
bio: A calico monarch who governs from the nearest comfortable surface. A single glance is enough to silence her court.

stand.name: QUEEN'S DECREE
stand.description: Within her chosen territory, everyone instinctively makes room for Alley. The longer she sits without moving, the wider her dominion grows.
stand.limitation: The spell breaks instantly if someone opens a can of tuna.

quote: You may approach. You may not touch the throne.

name: COCAINE
caption: Meet Cocaine, the most lazy and sleepy male cat in Katraj.
bio: A snowy-looking master of strategic inactivity. He has never rushed for a single thing, and somehow always wins.

stand.name: DREAM STATIC
stand.description: Creates a soothing field that slows movement and muffles noise. Opponents become overwhelmed by the need for a tiny nap.
stand.limitation: The aura vanishes when Cocaine himself wakes up.

quote: Five more minutes. That is an order.

name: HONA
caption: Paws, purrs and coffee vibes at Nine Lives Cat Cafe!
bio: A gray-and-white fluff with enormous amber eyes and a talent for finding the sunniest seat in the café.

stand.name: VELVET FREQUENCY
stand.description: A perfectly tuned purr nudges everyone nearby toward friendship, unexpected confessions, and a second cup of coffee.
stand.limitation: Has no effect over the noise of a coffee grinder.

quote: The café is neutral territory. The treats are not.

name: CAMPUS MEOWIE
caption: Meet this handsome meowie from near SGS mall, Camp #camppune
bio: Cream-colored, sharp-eyed, and apparently unconvinced that human beings have learned anything at all.

stand.name: GOLDEN HOUR
stand.description: Slows his perception of time during a fleeting patch of afternoon sunshine, allowing him to choose the ideal next step.
stand.limitation: Power declines sharply when the sun slips behind a building.

quote: You call it loitering. I call it research.

name: KUROHANA
caption: Instagram post tagged #japancat. Exact place and date not verified.
bio: A bright-eyed tortoiseshell whose gaze through the window makes it feel like she knows more than the people on either side.

stand.name: GLASS MIRAGE
stand.description: Can project a convincing phantom of herself into reflective surfaces, leading onlookers toward the wrong window.
stand.limitation: Cannot cross a reflection without a clear line of sight.

quote: The window shows you only what I allow.

name: SORA
caption: A cat pictured on a path; post tagged #japancat, July 12 (year unverified).
bio: A tabby-and-white traveler who pauses mid-journey, turns around, and decides whether you deserve the honor of following.

stand.name: WAYFARER'S ECHO
stand.description: Leaves quiet afterimages along paths already traveled. Every shadow becomes a breadcrumb visible only to trusted companions.
stand.limitation: The trail fades when rain touches the ground.

quote: A road is a promise, not a destination.

name: KALI
caption: Black-and-white cat resting beneath a vehicle; posted with #catlife and #catlovers.
bio: The black-and-white wanderer who treats the space under parked vehicles as a personal secret hideout.

stand.name: MELTING POINT
stand.description: Flattens the outline of nearby shadows, allowing Kali to disappear in plain sight under the smallest cover.
stand.limitation: A bright overhead light makes the exit extremely awkward.

quote: I was here the whole time. You weren't looking.

name: MIKA & MOMO
location: New York, USA — exact location unconfirmed
caption: Two tabby cats on a chair behind a railing; original post tagged #newyorkcat.
bio: Two tabby sentries. One watches the street, the other watches you. Neither has accepted the explanation for your presence.

stand.name: DOUBLE EXPOSURE
stand.description: Mika and Momo can swap their perceived positions for a blink, making every observer second-guess which twin moved first.
stand.limitation: Requires both cats to be awake and within sight of each other.
